newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - SOME SHARES GAIN, MOOD CAUTIOUS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - SOME SHARES GAIN, MOOD CAUTIOUS.

text.p: Lithuania shares showed signs of picking up on Friday and dealers were cautiously optimistic.
"Fourteen shares gained, nine went down and five remained unchanged in A group," Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema, told Reuters.
Big blue chips extended their recent gains.
Lithuania Gas rose to 1.80 litas from 1.67 litas, Baltijos Shipyard inched to 7.85 litas from 7.60 litas and TV screen produce Ekranas advanced to 4.77 litas from 4.60 litas.
"The prices were too low and so it's natural that they will rebound," Grazhina Bachiuliene of Vilfima said, adding that it was too early to detect a trend.
Kalnapilis brewery continued to slide, falling to 5.25 litas from 5.77 litas.
"Foreign investors like the company and so its price will probably fall no further than 4.80 litas," Andrejauskas said.
Spirits producer Seam fell by 6.2 percent to 6.05 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese dipped to 42.50 litas from 42.99 litas and its turnover today is likely to be between 200,000 and 300,000 litas, dealers said.
"Dealers suspect that Rokishkiss foreign investor is acting as a market maker," Andriejauskas said.
The banking sector remained cool with Vilniaus Bank inching down 1.28 percent to 232 litas.
